name: Dong-ari
source:
Jae-Woo Jeon, a naive freshman, happened to step into the P&M theater club. Little did he know it was a club full of flirting campus queens. Will Jae-Woo be able to safely go through his bumpy campus life?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
天真的新生全宰宇 (Jae-Woo Jeon) 偶然走进了P&M戏剧俱乐部。他几乎不知道这是一个充满调情校园女王的俱乐部。在宇能否安然度过坎坷的校园生活呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741820/]Steam[/url]]
